faq.question: What makes a video podcast different?
faq.answer: A video podcast is recorded with cameras as well as microphones, so the content can be used on YouTube, LinkedIn, websites and social platforms.

faq.question: Can Birdcast handle cameras and audio?
faq.answer: Yes. The studio setup is built around professional cameras, microphones, lighting and production support.

faq.question: Can a video podcast become social clips?
faq.answer: Yes. A video podcast session can be planned so parts of the conversation become reels, shorts or highlight edits.

faq.question: Can I choose the visual set?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast has different podcast sets with different moods and visual styles.

faq.question: Should I book or message first?
faq.answer: For a standard podcast session, booking is fine. For a custom setup, guest format or clip package, WhatsApp is better.
